description: Build a cost-utility analysis (ICER, QALY, PSA, sensitivity analysis) for a drug vs comparator. Follows ISPOR good practice guidelines and NICE reference case. Includes probabilistic sensitivity analysis (PSA), one-way sensitivity, and cost-effectiveness acceptability curve (CEAC). NOTE: utility inputs are value-set-dependent — UK submissions in 2026+ will transition from DSU 3L→5L mapping to the new UK EQ-5D-5L value set (NICE consultation 2026-04-15 to 2026-05-13). Use utility_value_set tool to check expected impact on ICER before finalising inputs.

ai_disclosure_level.description: AI assistance disclosure level. "off" = no disclosure; "standard" = default (model/tools/sources/date + human-review reminder); "submission" = adds ISPOR ELEVATE-GenAI citation. Default is tool-specific.

clinical_inputs.description: Clinical efficacy and safety parameters driving the Markov transitions.

efficacy_delta.description: Relative efficacy of intervention vs comparator (0-1). Higher = stronger treatment effect. Drives probability of staying on treatment.

mortality_reduction.description: Relative mortality reduction (0-1). E.g., 0.2 = 20% lower mortality vs baseline 2%.

cost_inputs.description: Annual costs per patient in the base currency for the selected perspective.

admin_cost.description: Annual administration cost (applies to both arms if shared).

comparator_cost_annual.description: Annual drug acquisition cost for the comparator.

drug_cost_annual.description: Annual drug acquisition cost for the intervention.

decisions.description: Methodological decisions made in conversation (source selection, comparator choice, screening criteria, model structure...). Each entry records the choice, the rationale (why), alternatives rejected, and who decided. Embedded in the audit trail Decision Log and, when a project is supplied, appended to wiki/decisions.md for cross-session recall. Tools never invent decisions — only pass what the user made or confirmed. Design log #52.

decided_by.description: Who made the decision — mark honestly

references.description: DOI/PMID/URL — recorded verbatim, rendered as unverified unless verified via utils.verify_citations

mfn_sensitivity.description: Optional MFN price-sensitivity sweep. When supplied, the output includes an mfn_sensitivity block with ICER per price point and WTP-crossover prices. Design log #27.

current_us_price.description: Upper bound — the drug's current US net price. Must be >= min_basket.

min_basket.description: Lower bound of the price sweep. Typically min(basket excluding US) from the 19-country GUARD/GLOBE MFN basket.

n_points.description: Number of price points in the sweep (default 11, max 101).

wtp_thresholds.description: WTP thresholds in $/QALY for crossover detection. Defaults to [30000, 100000, 150000].

model_type.description: Model type. Default: markov. Use 'partsa' for oncology — requires survival_inputs (the handler now hard-fails when partsa is set without it).

output_format.description: Use 'xlsx' for a structured Excel report with inputs, transition matrix, PSA iterations, and CEAC in separate tabs. The workbook is a REPORT — editing cells does not re-run the model. Re-run by calling the tool again with modified parameters.

perspective.description: Economic perspective: 'nhs' (UK NHS, WTP £25-35K/QALY), 'us_payer' ($100-150K/QALY ICER standard), or 'societal' (broader costs incl. productivity).

project.description: Project ID for knowledge base persistence. When set, model run is saved to ~/.heor-agent/projects/{project}/raw/models/

run_owsa.description: Run one-way sensitivity analysis (default: true). Set to false to skip OWSA and speed up large PSA runs.

scenarios.description: Optional scenario analysis: array of named parameter overrides. Each scenario re-runs the model with the specified changes. Max 10 scenarios.

overrides.description: Parameter overrides (time_horizon, perspective, clinical_inputs, cost_inputs, utility_inputs)

summary_metric.description: Summary metric for the ICER numerator. 'qaly' (default, NICE reference case), 'evlyg' (equal value life-years gained — CMS IRA-compatible; CMS prohibits QALYs in Medicare IRA drug price negotiations per §1194(e)(2)), or 'both' to report both side-by-side.

survival_inputs.description: Required when model_type='partsa'. Median survival inputs (months) for OS/PFS, optional comparator overrides, and parametric distribution choice. Codex P1 fix (2026-05-07).

time_horizon.description: Modelling horizon: 'lifetime', '5yr', '10yr', or years as number

utility_inputs.description: QALY weights for each health state (optional — defaults derived from efficacy if omitted).

qaly_comparator.description: Utility weight (0-1) for comparator / off-treatment state.

qaly_on_treatment.description: Utility weight (0-1) for on-treatment state. 1=perfect health, 0=death.

name: models.cost_effectiveness
